systems.country_label: Tasdjil; Guichets Uniques d'Enregistrement des naissances
systems.platform: developed by the NGO Technidev; works without internet
systems.owner: Agence nationale des titres sécurisés (ANATS), with UNICEF support
systems.tiers: civil-status offices inside hospitals: six in N'Djamena and 12 provincial and district hospitals as at 2023-11-16; a pilot phase, with more to open

note: Tasdjil as described here is ANATS's system run in hospital-based offices by health staff, and it works offline; no commune office or its connection is described.
